title: PROVENANCE CORRECTION: 'Kosulsuz arXiv:2610.09982' is a phantom — 09982 is a Shi-Zuo algebraic-geometry paper (Bernstein-Sato roots, determinantal/Pfaffian monodromy), and no mathematician named Kosulsuz exists; the 0136/0137 queue pointer is void
body: Fetched arXiv 2610.09982 to begin the 'next reading unit' recorded in discoveries 0136 and 0137. The e-print (tarball sha256 6203b1408861701c019d26ec3f9e8150902d09d9810ceb663e0b22bf73643e6d, on file in tmp/b6audit/kosulsuz/) is 'A combinatorial criterion for detecting roots of Bernstein-Sato polynomials' by Quan Shi and Huaiqing Zuo (Tsinghua) -- algebraic geometry (MSC 14F10): the strong monodromy conjecture for determinantal and Pfaffian ideals via a characteristic-p criterion of Mustata-Takagi-Watanabe. NOTHING to do with the Riemann hypothesis. Targeted author searches for 'Kosulsuz' (and spell variants) find NO mathematician by that name -- the name is a phantom that entered the 0136 recon (an unmoored memory fragment with an unverified arXiv ID, exactly the failure mode the verified-footing rule exists to catch: a search-result-title-plus-ID is not a source). CORRECTION: the queue pointer 'Kosulsuz per-zero positive-moment certificate' is VOID; no such paper is on file. The replacement reading queue from the 2026-10-20 frontier sweep (all real, all ID-verified): (1) Bellotti-Trudgian-Yang, 'Zero-free regions inspired by work of Heath-Brown', arXiv 2603.21490 (March 2026) -- a NEW explicit classical zeta zero-free region from the Linnik-constant/Heath-Brown machinery; the only swept record potentially relevant to the in-tree frontier comparison (our earlier classical-region survey predates it); (2) the de Bruijn-Newman constant Lean formalization (arXiv, 2026-10-08): kernel-checked Lambda <= 9/32 composed from the OAI 7/8 half-plane, v1.1 sharpened to Lambda <= 0.2811857 from Liu's improved half-plane -- ecosystem proof that the B6-closed 003 foundation composes cleanly in Lean; (3) Mori's Zenodo 23355293/23355616 record (boundary 43747851/50000000 = 0.874957020, Liu-family, rational certificate + checker, 2026-10-14) -- weaker than [Z78T], provenance-pattern only. No in-tree change; no RH claim; [Z78T] remains the adopted frontier (board re-verified 2026-10-20: 24 records, top 174963413/200000000).
